Paak o paakeeza hai woh Parwardigar jo apne bande ko raaton raat Masjid-ul-Haraam se Masjid-ul-Aqsa tak le gaya jis ke atraaf ko hum ne ba-barakat banaaya hai, taake hum use apni ba'z nishaaniyaan dikhlaayein. Beshak woh Parwardigar sab ki sunne waala aur sab kuch dekhne waala hai
Aur hum ne Moosa ko kitaab inaayat ki aur us kitaab ko Bani Israaeel ke liye hidaayat bana diya ke khabardaar mere ilaawa kisi ko apna kaarsaaz na banaana
Yeh Bani Israaeel un ki aulaad hain jin ko hum ne Nooh ke saath kashti mein uthaaya tha, jo hamaare shukr-guzaar bande the
Aur hum ne Bani Israaeel ko kitaab mein yeh ittilaa bhi de di thi ke tum zameen mein do martaba fasaad karoge aur khoob bulandi haasil karoge

Us ke baad jab pehle waade ka waqt aa gaya to hum ne tumhaare oopar apne un bandon ko musallat kar diya jo bahut sakht qism ke jangjoo the, aur unhon ne tumhaare diyaar mein chun chun kar tumhein maara, aur yeh hamaara hone waala waada tha
Us ke baad hum ne tumhein dobaara un par ghalaba diya aur amwaal o aulaad se tumhaari madad ki aur tumhein bade giroh waala bana diya

Ab tum nek amal karoge to apne liye, aur bura karoge to apne liye karoge. Us ke baad jab doosre waade ka waqt aa gaya to hum ne doosri qaum ko musallat kar diya taake tumhaari shaklein bigaad dein, aur masjid mein is tarah daakhil hon jis tarah pehle daakhil hue the, aur jis cheez par bhi qaaboo pa lein use baa-qaa'ida tabaah o barbaad kar dein
Umeed hai ke tumhaara Parwardigar tum par rahm kar de, lekin agar tum ne dobaara fasaad kiya to hum phir saza denge, aur hum ne Jahannam ko kaafiron ke liye ek qaid-khaana bana diya hai
Beshak yeh Quran us raaste ki hidaayat karta hai jo bilkul seedha hai, aur un saahibaan-e-imaan ko bashaarat deta hai jo nek aamaal baja laate hain ke un ke liye bahut bada ajr hai
Aur jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain un ke liye hum ne ek dardnaak azaab muhayya kar rakha hai
Aur insaan kabhi kabhi apne haq mein bhalaai ki tarah buraai ki dua maangne lagta hai, ke insaan bahut jald-baaz waaqe hua hai

Aur hum ne raat aur din ko apni nishaani qaraar diya hai, phir hum raat ki nishaani ko mita dete hain aur din ki nishaani ko raushan kar dete hain taake tum apne Parwardigar ke fazl o in'aam ko talab kar sako aur saal aur hisaab ke a'daad maaloom kar sako, aur hum ne har shai ko tafseel ke saath bayaan kar diya hai
Aur hum ne har insaan ke naama-e-aamaal ko us ki gardan mein aaweezaan kar diya hai, aur roz-e-qiyaamat use ek khuli hui kitaab ki tarah pesh kar denge
Ke ab apni kitaab ko padh lo, aaj tumhaare hisaab ke liye yahi kitaab kaafi hai

Jo shakhs bhi hidaayat haasil karta hai woh apne faaide ke liye karta hai, aur jo gumraahi ikhtiyaar karta hai woh bhi apna hi nuqsaan karta hai, aur koi kisi ka bojh uthaane waala nahin hai, aur hum to us waqt tak azaab karne waale nahin hain jab tak ke koi rasool na bhej dein

Aur hum ne jab bhi kisi qarya ko halaak karna chaaha to us ke sarwat-mandon par ahkaam naafiz kar diye, aur unhon ne un ki naafarmaani ki, to hamaari baat saabit ho gayi aur hum ne use mukammal taur par tabaah kar diya
Aur hum ne Nooh ke baad bhi kitni ummaton ko halaak kar diya hai, aur tumhaara Parwardigar bandon ke gunaahon ka behtareen jaanne waala aur dekhne waala hai
Jo shakhs bhi duniya ka talabgaar hai hum us ke liye jald hi jo chaahte hain de dete hain, phir us ke baad us ke liye Jahannam hai jis mein woh zillat o ruswaai ke saath daakhil hoga
Aur jo shakhs aakhirat ka chaahne waala hai aur us ke liye waisi hi sa'i bhi karta hai aur saahib-e-imaan bhi hai to us ki sa'i yaqeenan maqbool qaraar di jaaegi
Hum aap ke Parwardigar ki ata o bakhshish se in ki aur un ki sab ki madad karte hain, aur aap ke Parwardigar ki ata kisi par band nahin hai
Aap dekhiye ke hum ne kis tarah ba'z ko ba'z par fazeelat di hai, aur phir aakhirat ke darajaat aur wahaan ki fazeelatein to aur zyaada buzurg o bartar hain
Khabardaar apne Parwardigar ke saath koi doosra khuda qaraar na dena ke is tarah qaabil-e-mazammat aur laawaaris baithe reh jaaoge, aur koi khuda kaam na aaega

Aur aap ke Parwardigar ka faisla hai ke tum sab us ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karna, aur maa baap ke saath achchha bartaao karna, aur agar tumhaare saamne un dono mein se koi ek ya dono boodhe ho jaayein to khabardaar un se uff bhi na kehna aur unhein jhidakna bhi nahin, aur un se hamesha shareefaana guftugu karte rehna

Aur un ke liye khaaksaari ke saath apne kaandhon ko jhuka dena, aur un ke haq mein dua karte rehna ke Parwardigar! Un dono par usi tarah rehmat naazil farma jis tarah ke unhon ne bachpane mein mujhe paala hai
Tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaare dilon ke haalaat se khoob baakhabar hai, aur agar tum saaleh aur nek kirdaar ho to woh tauba karne waalon ke liye bahut bakhshne waala bhi hai
Aur dekho qaraabat-daaron ko aur miskeen ko aur musaafir-e-ghurbat-zada ko us ka haq de do, aur khabardaar israaf se kaam na lena
Israaf karne waale shayaateen ke bhai-band hain, aur Shaitaan to apne Parwardigar ka bahut bada inkaar karne waala hai
Agar tum ko apne Rab ki rehmat ke intezaar mein jis ke tum umeedwaar ho un afraad se kinaara-kash bhi hona pade to un se narm andaaz se guftugu karna
Aur khabardaar na apne haathon ko gardanon se bandha hua qaraar do aur na bilkul phaila do ke aakhir mein qaabil-e-malaamat aur khaali haath baithe reh jaao
Tumhaara Parwardigar jis ke liye chaahta hai rizq ko wasee' ya tang bana deta hai, woh apne bandon ke haalaat ka khoob jaanne waala aur dekhne waala hai
Aur khabardaar apni aulaad ko faaqe ke khauf se qatl na karna, ke hum inhein bhi rizq dete hain aur tumhein bhi rizq dete hain. Beshak un ka qatl kar dena bahut bada gunaah hai
Aur dekho zina ke qareeb bhi na jaana ke yeh badkaari hai aur bahut bura raasta hai

Aur kisi nafs ko jis ko Khuda ne mohtaram banaaya hai baghair haq ke qatl bhi na karna. Ke jo mazloom qatl hota hai hum us ke wali ko badle ka ikhtiyaar de dete hain, lekin use bhi chaahiye ke qatl mein hadd se aage na badh jaaye, ke us ki bahar-haal madad ki jaaegi
Aur yateem ke maal ke qareeb bhi na jaana magar us tarah jo behtareen tareeqa hai, yahaan tak ke woh tawaana ho jaaye. Aur apne ahdon ko poora karna ke ahd ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega
Aur jab naapo to poora naapo, aur jab tolo to saheeh taraazu se tolo, ke yahi behtari aur behtareen anjaam ka zariya hai
Aur jis cheez ka tumhein ilm nahin hai us ke peechhe mat jaana, ke roz-e-qiyaamat samaa'at, basaarat aur quwwat-e-qalb sab ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega
Aur roo-e-zameen par akad kar na chalna, ke na tum zameen ko shaq kar sakte ho aur na sar utha kar pahaadon ki bulandiyon tak pahunch sakte ho
Yeh sab baatein woh hain jin ki buraai tumhaare Parwardigar ke nazdeek sakht naapasand hai

Yeh woh hikmat hai jis ki wahi tumhaare Parwardigar ne tumhaari taraf ki hai, aur khabardaar Khuda ke saath kisi aur ko khuda na qaraar dena ke Jahannam mein malaamat aur zillat ke saath daal diye jaao
Kya tumhaare Parwardigar ne tum logon ke liye ladkon ko pasand kiya hai aur apne liye malaaika mein se ladkiyaan banaayi hain? Yeh tum bahut badi baat keh rahe ho
Aur hum ne is Quran mein sab kuch tarah tarah se bayaan kar diya hai ke yeh log ibrat haasil karein, lekin un ki nafrat hi mein izaafa ho raha hai
To aap keh dijiye ke un ke kehne ke mutaabiq agar Khuda ke saath kuch aur khuda bhi hote to ab tak Saahib-e-Arsh tak pahunchne ki koi raah nikaal lete
Woh paak aur be-niyaaz hai, aur un ki baaton se bahut zyaada buland o baala hai

Saaton aasmaan aur zameen aur jo kuch un ke darmiyaan hai sab us ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain, aur koi shai aisi nahin hai jo us ki tasbeeh na karti ho, yeh aur baat hai ke tum un ki tasbeeh ko nahin samajhte ho. Parwardigar bahut bardaasht karne waala aur darguzar karne waala hai
Aur jab tum Quran padhte ho to hum tumhaare aur aakhirat par imaan na rakhne waalon ke darmiyaan hijaab qaaim kar dete hain

Aur un ke dilon par parde daal dete hain ke kuch samajh na sakein, aur un ke kaanon ko behra bana dete hain, aur jab tum Quran mein apne Parwardigar ka tanha zikr karte ho to yeh ulte paaon mutanaffir ho kar bhaag jaate hain

Hum khoob jaante hain ke yeh log aap ki taraf kaan laga kar sunte hain to kya sunte hain, aur jab yeh baaham raazdaari ki baatein karte hain to hum use bhi jaante hain. Yeh zaalim aapas mein kehte hain ke tum log ek jaadoo-zada insaan ki pairwi kar rahe ho
Zara dekho ke unhon ne tumhaare liye kaisi misaalein bayaan ki hain, aur is tarah aise gumraah ho gaye hain ke koi raasta nahin mil raha hai
Aur yeh kehte hain ke jab hum haddi aur khaak ho jaayenge to kya dobaara nayi makhlooq bana kar uthaaye jaayenge
Aap keh dijiye ke tum patthar ya loha ban jaao

Ya tumhaare khayaal mein jo is se badi makhlooq ho sakti ho woh ban jaao. Pas anqareeb yeh log kahenge ke humein kaun dobaara waapas la sakta hai? To keh dijiye ke jis ne tumhein pehli martaba paida kiya hai. Phir yeh log istehza mein sar hilaayenge aur kahenge ke yeh sab kab hoga? To keh dijiye ke shaayad qareeb hi ho jaaye
Jis din woh tumhein bulaaega aur tum sab us ki taareef karte hue labbaik kahoge, aur khayaal karoge ke bahut thodi der duniya mein rahe ho
Aur mere bandon se keh dijiye ke sirf achchhi baatein kiya karein, warna Shaitaan yaqeenan un ke darmiyaan fasaad paida karna chaahega, ke Shaitaan insaan ka khula hua dushman hai
Tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaare haalaat se behtar waaqif hai, woh chaahega to tum par rahm karega aur chaahega to azaab karega, aur Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko un ka zimmedaar bana kar nahin bheja hai
Aur aap ka Parwardigar zameen o aasmaan ki har shai se baakhabar hai, aur hum ne ba'z anbiya ko ba'z par fazeelat di hai aur Dawood ko Zaboor ata ki hai
Aur un logon se keh dijiye ke Khuda ke ilaawa jin ka bhi khayaal hai sab ko bula lein, koi na un ki takleef ko door karne ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hai aur na un ke haalaat ke badalne ka

Yeh jin ko khuda samajh kar pukaarte hain woh khud hi apne Parwardigar ke liye waseela talaash kar rahe hain ke kaun zyaada qurbat rakhne waala hai, aur sab usi ki rehmat ke umeedwaar aur usi ke azaab se khaufzada hain. Yaqeenan aap ke Parwardigar ka azaab darne ke laaiq hai
Aur koi naafarmaan aabaadi aisi nahin hai jise hum qiyaamat se pehle barbaad na kar dein ya us par shadeed azaab na naazil kar dein, ke yeh baat kitaab mein likh di gayi hai

Aur hamaare liye munh-maangi nishaaniyaan bhejne se sirf yeh baat maane' hai ke pehle waalon ne takzeeb ki hai aur halaak ho gaye hain, aur hum ne qaum-e-Samood ko un ki khwaahish ke mutaabiq oontni de di jo hamaari qudrat ko raushan karne waali thi, lekin un logon ne us par zulm kiya, aur hum to nishaaniyon ko sirf daraane ke liye bhejte hain

Aur jab hum ne keh diya ke aap ka Parwardigar tamaam logon ke haalaat se baakhabar hai, aur jo khwaab hum ne aap ko dikhlaaya hai woh sirf logon ki aazmaaish ka zariya hai, jis tarah ke Quran mein qaabil-e-la'nat shajara bhi aisa hi hai, aur hum logon ko daraate rehte hain lekin un ki sarkashi badhti hi ja rahi hai
Aur jab hum ne malaaika se kaha ke Aadam ko sajda karo to sab ne sajda kar liya siwaaye Iblees ke, ke us ne kaha ke kya main use sajda karoon jise tu ne mitti se banaaya hai

Kya tu ne dekha hai ke yeh kya shai hai jise mere oopar fazeelat de di hai? Ab agar tu ne mujhe qiyaamat tak ki mohlat de di to main is ki zurriyat mein chand afraad ke ilaawa sab ka gala ghontta rahoonga
Jawaab mila ke ja, ab jo bhi tera ittibaa' karega tum sab ki jaza mukammal taur par Jahannam hai

Ja, jis par bhi bas chale apni aawaaz se gumraah kar, aur apne sawaar aur pyaadon se hamla kar de, aur un ke amwaal aur aulaad mein shareek ho ja, aur un se khoob waade kar, ke Shaitaan siwaaye dhoka dene ke aur koi sachcha waada nahin kar sakta hai
Beshak mere asli bandon par tera koi bas nahin hai, aur aap ka Parwardigar un ki nigehbaani ke liye kaafi hai
Aur aap ka Parwardigar hi woh hai jo tum logon ke liye samandar mein kashtiyaan chalaata hai taake tum us ke fazl o karam ko talaash kar sako, ke woh tumhaare haal par bada meharbaan hai

Aur jab darya mein tumhein koi takleef pahunchi to Khuda ke ilaawa sab ghaaib ho gaye jinhein tum pukaar rahe the, aur phir jab Khuda ne tumhein bacha kar khushki tak pahuncha diya to tum phir kinaara-kash ho gaye, aur insaan to bada naashukra hai
Kya tum is baat se mahfooz ho gaye ho ke woh tumhein khushki hi mein dhansa de ya tum par pattharon ki bauchhaar kar de aur us ke baad phir koi kaarsaaz na mile

Ya is baat se mahfooz ho gaye ho ke woh dobaara tumhein samandar mein le jaaye aur phir tez aandhiyon ko bhej kar tumhaare kufr ki bina par tumhein gharq kar de, aur us ke baad koi aisa na paao jo hamaare hukm ka peechha kar sake

Aur hum ne Bani Aadam ko karaamat ata ki hai, aur inhein khushki aur daryaaon mein sawaariyon par uthaaya hai, aur inhein paakeeza rizq ata kiya hai, aur apni makhlooqaat mein se bahut son par fazeelat di hai

Qiyaamat ka din woh hoga jab hum har giroh-e-insaani ko us ke peshwa ke saath bulaayenge, aur us ke baad jin ka naama-e-aamaal un ke daahine haath mein diya jaaega woh apne saheefe ko padhenge, aur un par resha baraabar zulm nahin hoga
Aur jo isi duniya mein andha hai woh qiyaamat mein bhi andha aur bhatka hua rahega
Aur yeh zaalim is baat ke koshaan the ke aap ko hamaari wahi se hata kar doosri baaton ke iftira par aamaada kar dein, aur is tarah yeh aap ko apna dost bana lete
Aur agar hamaari taufeeq-e-khaas ne aap ko saabit-qadam na rakha hota to aap (bashari taur par) kuch na kuch un ki taraf maail zaroor ho jaate
Aur phir hum zindagaani-e-duniya aur maut dono marhalon par dohra maza chakhaate, aur aap hamaare khilaaf koi madadgaar aur kumak karne waala bhi na paate
Aur yeh log aap ko zameen-e-Makka se dil-bardaashta kar rahe the ke wahaan se nikaal dein, haalaanke aap ke baad yeh bhi thode dinon se zyaada na thehar sakte
Yeh aap se pehle bheje jaane waale rasoolon mein hamaara tareeqa-e-kaar raha hai, aur aap hamaare tareeqa-e-kaar mein koi taghayyur na paayenge
Aap zawaal-e-aaftaab se raat ki taareeki tak namaaz qaaim karein, aur namaaz-e-subah bhi, ke namaaz-e-subah ke liye gawaahi ka intezaam kiya gaya hai
Aur raat ke ek hisse mein Quran ke saath bedaar rahein, yeh aap ke liye izaafa-e-khair hai. Anqareeb aap ka Parwardigar isi tarah aap ko Maqaam-e-Mahmood tak pahuncha dega
Aur yeh kahiye ke Parwardigar! Mujhe achchhi tarah se aabaadi mein daakhil kar aur behtareen andaaz se baahar nikaal, aur mere liye ek taaqat qaraar de de jo meri madadgaar saabit ho
Aur keh dijiye ke haq aa gaya aur baatil fana ho gaya, ke baatil bahar-haal fana hone waala hai
Aur hum Quran mein woh sab kuch naazil kar rahe hain jo saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye shifa aur rehmat hai, aur zaalimeen ke liye khasaare mein izaafe ke ilaawa kuch na hoga
Aur hum jab insaan par koi ne'mat naazil karte hain to woh pehlu bacha kar kinaara-kash ho jaata hai, aur jab takleef hoti hai to maayoos ho jaata hai
Aap keh dijiye ke har ek apne tareeqe par amal karta hai, to tumhaara Parwardigar bhi khoob jaanta hai ke kaun sab se zyaada seedhe raaste par hai
Aur Paighambar! Yeh aap se rooh ke baare mein daryaaft karte hain, to keh dijiye ke yeh mere Parwardigar ka ek amr hai, aur tumhein bahut thoda sa ilm diya gaya hai
Aur agar hum chaahein to jo kuch aap ko wahi ke zariye diya gaya hai use utha lein, aur us ke baad hamaare muqaable mein koi kaarsaaz aur zimmedaar na mile
Magar yeh ke aap ke Parwardigar ki meharbaani ho jaaye, ke us ka fazl aap par bahut bada hai

Aap keh dijiye ke agar insaan aur jinnaat sab is baat par muttafiq ho jaayein ke is Quran ka misl le aayein to bhi nahin la sakte, chaahe sab ek doosre ke madadgaar aur pusht-panaah hi kyon na ho jaayein
Aur hum ne is Quran mein saari misaalein ulat palat kar bayaan kar di hain, lekin us ke baad phir bhi aksar logon ne kufr ke ilaawa har baat se inkaar kar diya hai
Aur un logon ne kehna shuroo kar diya ke hum tum par imaan na laayenge jab tak hamaare liye zameen se chashma na jaari kar do
Ya tumhaare paas khajoor aur angoor ke baagh hon jin ke darmiyaan tum nahrein jaari kar do
Ya hamaare oopar apne khayaal ke mutaabiq aasmaan ko tukde tukde kar ke gira do, ya Allah aur malaaika ko hamaare saamne la kar khada kar do

Ya tumhaare paas sone ka koi makaan ho, ya tum aasmaan ki bulandi par chadh jaao, aur us bulandi par bhi hum imaan na laayenge jab tak koi aisi kitaab naazil na kar do jise hum padh lein. Aap keh dijiye ke hamaara Parwardigar bada be-niyaaz hai, aur main sirf ek bashar hoon jise rasool bana kar bheja gaya hai
Aur hidaayat ke aa jaane ke baad logon ke liye imaan laane se koi shai maane' nahin hui magar yeh ke kehne lage ke kya Khuda ne kisi bashar ko rasool bana kar bhej diya hai
To aap keh dijiye ke agar zameen mein malaaika itmenaan se tahalte hote to hum aasmaan se farishte hi ko rasool bana kar bhejte
Keh dijiye ke hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan gawaah banne ke liye Khuda kaafi hai, ke wahi apne bandon ke haalaat se baakhabar hai aur un ki kaifiyaat ka dekhne waala hai

Aur jis ko Khuda hidaayat de de wahi hidaayat-yaafta hai, aur jis ko gumraahi mein chhod de us ke liye us ke ilaawa koi madadgaar na paaoge. Aur hum inhein roz-e-qiyaamat munh ke bal goonge andhe behre mahshoor karenge, aur un ka thikaana Jahannam hoga, ke jis ki aag bujhne bhi lagegi to hum sho'lon ko mazeed bhadka denge
Yeh is baat ki saza hai ke unhon ne hamaari nishaaniyon ka inkaar kiya hai aur yeh kaha hai ke hum haddiyaan aur mitti ka dher ban jaayenge to kya dobaara az-sar-e-nau phir paida kiye jaayenge

Kya un logon ne yeh nahin dekha hai ke jis ne aasmaan o zameen ko paida kiya hai woh in ka jaisa doosra bhi paida karne par qaadir hai, aur us ne un ke liye ek muddat muqarrar kar di hai jis mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai, magar zaalimon ne kufr ke ilaawa har cheez se inkaar kar diya hai
Aap keh dijiye ke agar tum log mere Parwardigar ke khazaanon ke maalik hote to kharch ho jaane ke khauf se sab rok lete, aur insaan to tang-dil hi waaqe hua hai
Aur hum ne Moosa ko nau khuli hui nishaaniyaan di thin, to Bani Israaeel se poochho ke jab Moosa un ke paas aaye to Fir'aun ne un se keh diya ke main to tum ko sehar-zada khayaal kar raha hoon

Moosa ne kaha ke tumhein maaloom hai ke yeh sab mo'jizaat aasmaan o zameen ke maalik ne baseerat ka saamaan bana kar naazil kiye hain, aur aye Fir'aun! Main khayaal kar raha hoon ke teri shaamat aa gayi hai
Fir'aun ne chaaha ke un logon ko is sarzameen se nikaal baahar kar de, lekin hum ne us ko us ke saathiyon samet darya mein gharq kar diya
Aur us ke baad Bani Israaeel se keh diya ke ab zameen mein aabaad ho jaao, phir jab aakhirat ke waade ka waqt aa jaaega to hum tum sab ko samet kar le aayenge
Aur hum ne is Quran ko haq ke saath naazil kiya hai aur yeh haq hi ke saath naazil hua hai, aur hum ne aap ko sirf bashaarat dene waala aur daraane waala bana kar bheja hai
Aur hum ne Quran ko mutafarriq bana kar naazil kiya hai taake tum thoda thoda logon ke saamne padho, aur hum ne khud ise tadreejan naazil kiya hai
Aap keh dijiye ke tum imaan laao ya na laao, jin ko is ke pehle ilm de diya gaya hai un par tilaawat hoti hai to munh ke bal sajde mein gir padte hain
Aur kehte hain ke hamaara Rab paak o paakeeza hai, aur us ka waada yaqeenan poora hone waala hai
Aur woh munh ke bal gir padte hain, rote hain, aur woh Quran un ke khushoo' mein izaafa kar deta hai

Aap keh dijiye ke Allah keh kar pukaaro ya Rehmaan keh kar pukaaro, jis tarah bhi pukaaroge us ke tamaam naam behtareen hain. Aur apni namaazon ko na chilla kar padho aur na bahut aahista aahista, balke dono ka darmiyaani raasta nikaalo

Aur kaho ke saari hamd us Allah ke liye hai jis ne na kisi ko farzand banaaya hai aur na koi us ke mulk mein shareek hai, aur na koi us ki kamzori ki bina par us ka sarparast hai, aur phir baa-qaa'ida us ki buzurgi ka e'laan karte raho
